items.source: Asynchronous methods are re-implemented on AsyncCqlTemplate and AsyncCassandraTemplate by using ListenableFuture. We removed Cancellable and the various async callback listeners. ListenableFuture is a flexible approach and allows transition into a CompletableFuture.
items.translation: 异步方法在 `AsyncCqlTemplate` 和 `AsyncCassandraTemplate` 中通过使用 `ListenableFuture` 重新实现。我们移除了 `Cancellable` 以及各种异步回调监听器。`ListenableFuture` 是一种灵活的方法，并允许过渡到 `CompletableFuture`。

items.source: CassandraTemplate is no longer a CqlTemplate but uses an instance that allows reuse and fine-grained control over fetch size, consistency levels, and retry policies. You can obtain the CqlOperations through CassandraTemplate.getCqlOperations(). Because of the change, dependency injection of CqlTemplate requires additional bean setup.
items.translation:
<CassandraTemplate> 不再是一个 <CqlTemplate>，而是使用一个实例，该实例允许重用并对获取大小、一致性级别和重试策略进行细粒度控制。  
您可以通过 <CassandraTemplate.getCqlOperations()> 获取 <CqlOperations>。  
由于这一变更，对 <CqlTemplate> 的依赖注入需要额外的 Bean 配置。

`QueryOptions` 和 `WriteOptions` 现已不可变，可通过构建器创建。

以下示例展示了如何使用 `QueryOptions.builder()`：

items.source: Removed SD Cassandra ConsistencyLevel and RetryPolicy types in favor of DataStax ConsistencyLevel and RetryPolicy types.
items.translation: 已移除 SD 的 `ConsistencyLevel` 和 `RetryPolicy` 类型，改用 DataStax 的 `ConsistencyLevel` 和 `RetryPolicy` 类型。

items.source: CqlTemplate now reflects basic CQL operations instead of mixing high-level and low-level API calls (such as count(…) versus execute(…)) and the reduced method set is aligned with Spring Frameworks’s JdbcTemplate with its convenient callback interfaces.
items.translation: <CqlTemplate>现已反映基本的 CQL 操作，不再混合使用高级和低级 API 调用（例如<count(…)>与<execute(…)>），其精简的方法集已与 Spring Frameworks 的<JdbcTemplate>及其便捷的回调接口保持一致。

items.source: Deprecated CqlIdentifier.cqlId(…) and KeyspaceIdentifier.ksId(…) in favor of the .of(…) methods.
items.translation: 已弃用 CqlIdentifier.cqlId(…) 和 KeyspaceIdentifier.ksId(…)，转而推荐使用 .of(…) 方法。

items.source: Spring CQL and Spring Data Cassandra are now merged into a single module. The standalone spring-cql module is no longer available. You can find all types merged into spring-data-cassandra. The following listing shows how to include spring-data-cassandra in your maven dependencies:
items.translation: Spring CQL 和 Spring Data Cassandra 现已合并为一个模块。 独立的 `spring-cql` 模块不再可用。 所有类型现已合并到 `spring-data-cassandra` 中。 以下示例展示了如何在 Maven 依赖中包含 `spring-data-cassandra`：

items.source: As much as possible, CQL specification types are now value types (such as FieldSpecification, AlterColumnSpecification), and objects are constructed by static factory methods. This allows immutability for simple value objects. Configurator objects (such as AlterTableSpecification) that operate on mandatory properties (such as a table name or keyspace name) are initially constructed through a a static factory method and allow further configuration until the desired state is created.
items.translation: CQL 规范类型现在尽可能采用值类型（例如 `FieldSpecification`、`AlterColumnSpecification`），并通过静态工厂方法构建对象。这使得简单的值对象能够实现不可变性。配置器对象（例如 `AlterTableSpecification`）用于操作必需属性（如表名或键空间名称），它们最初通过静态工厂方法构建，并允许进一步配置，直到达到所需的状态。

items.source: CassandraPersistentProperty allowed previously multiple column names to be bound for composite primary key use. Columns of a CassandraPersistentProperty are now reduced to a single column. Resolved composite primary keys map to a class through MappingContext.getRequiredPersistentEntity(…).
items.translation: 之前，CassandraPersistentProperty 允许为复合主键绑定多个列名。现在，CassandraPersistentProperty 的列已缩减为单个列。解析后的复合主键通过 MappingContext.getRequiredPersistentEntity(…) 映射到类。

items.source: Merged the spring-cql and spring-data-cassandra modules into a single module.
items.translation: 将 `spring-cql` 和 `spring-data-cassandra` 模块合并为一个模块。

items.source: Separated asynchronous and synchronous operations in CqlOperations and CassandraOperations into dedicated interfaces and templates.
items.translation: 将异步和同步操作从 `CqlOperations` 和 `CassandraOperations` 中分离出来，并划分为专用的接口和模板。

items.source: Revised the CqlTemplate API to align with JdbcTemplate.
items.translation: 修订了CqlTemplateAPI，使其与JdbcTemplate保持一致。

items.source: Deprecated QueryOptionsBuilder.readTimeout(long, TimeUnit) in favor of QueryOptionsBuilder.readTimeout(Duration).
items.translation: 已弃用 QueryOptionsBuilder.readTimeout(long, TimeUnit)，推荐使用 QueryOptionsBuilder.readTimeout(Duration)。

items.source: Deprecated CustomConversions in favor of CassandraCustomConversions.
items.translation: 已弃用 CustomConversions，改用 CassandraCustomConversions。

items.source: Deprecated BasicCassandraMappingContext in favor of CassandraMappingContext.
items.translation: 已弃用 BasicCassandraMappingContext，推荐使用 CassandraMappingContext。

items.source: Deprecated o.s.d.c.core.cql.CachedPreparedStatementCreator in favor of o.s.d.c.core.cql.support.CachedPreparedStatementCreator.
items.translation: 已弃用 o.s.d.c.core.cql.CachedPreparedStatementCreator，推荐使用 o.s.d.c.core.cql.support.CachedPreparedStatementCreator。

items.source: Deprecated CqlTemplate.getSession() in favor of getSessionFactory().
items.translation: 已弃用 CqlTemplate.getSession()，推荐使用 getSessionFactory()。

items.source: Deprecated TypedIdCassandraRepository in favor of CassandraRepository
items.translation: 已弃用 TypedIdCassandraRepository，推荐使用 CassandraRepository

items.source: Merged o.s.d.cql with o.s.d.cassandra.config and flattened the XML and Java subpackages.
items.translation: 合并了o.s.d.cql与o.s.d.cassandra.config，并扁平化了 XML 和 Java 子包。

items.source: Moved Cassandra exceptions o.s.d.c.support.exception to o.s.d.cassandra.
items.translation: 将 Cassandra 异常 `o.s.d.c.support.exception` 移至 `o.s.d.cassandra`。

items.source: Moved o.s.d.c.convert to o.s.d.c.core.convert (affects converters).
items.translation: 已将o.s.d.c.convert移至o.s.d.c.core.convert（影响转换器）。

items.source: Moved o.s.d.c.mapping to o.s.d.c.core.mapping (affects mapping annotations).
items.translation: 已将 `o.s.d.c.mapping` 移至 `o.s.d.c.core.mapping`（影响映射注解）。

items.source: We split CqlTemplate and CassandraTemplate in three ways:
items.translation: 我们将 `CqlTemplate` 和 `CassandraTemplate` 从三个方面进行了拆分：

items.source: We renamed CassandraRepository and TypedIdCassandraRepository to align Spring Data Cassandra naming with other Spring Data modules:
items.translation: 我们将CassandraRepository和TypedIdCassandraRepository重命名，以使Spring Data Cassandra的命名与其他Spring Data模块保持一致：

items.source: Introduced TypedIdCassandraRepository, extending CassandraRepository as a deprecated type to ease migration
items.translation: 引入 TypedIdCassandraRepository，将其作为已弃用类型扩展自 CassandraRepository，以简化迁移工作。

items.source: Spring Data Cassandra ConsistencyLevel and RetryPolicy have been removed. Please use the types provided by the DataStax driver.
items.translation: Spring Data Cassandra 中的ConsistencyLevel和RetryPolicy已被移除。请使用 DataStax 驱动程序提供的类型。

items.source: Removed the CassandraOperations.selectBySimpleIds method.
items.translation: 已移除 `CassandraOperations.selectBySimpleIds` 方法。

items.source: Used better names for CassandraRepository.
items.translation: 为 `CassandraRepository` 使用了更合适的名称。

items.source: Refactored QueryOptions to be immutable objects.
items.translation: 重构了QueryOptions，使其成为不可变对象。

items.source: Refactored CassandraPersistentProperty to single-column.
items.translation: 重构了单列的 CassandraPersistentProperty。

items.source: Deprecated constructors of QueryOptions in favor of their builders.
items.translation: 已弃用 `QueryOptions` 的构造函数，建议使用其构建器。

items.translation: 将 CQL 规范重构为值对象和配置器。

items.source:
The Spring Data Cassandra types restricted usage of available features provided in and allowed by the Cassandra native driver.
As a result, the Spring Data Cassandra’s types required an update each time newer functionality was introduced by the driver.
items.translation:
Spring Data Cassandra 的类型限制了 Cassandra 原生驱动所提供的可用功能的使用。  
因此，每当驱动引入新功能时，Spring Data Cassandra 的类型都需要进行更新。

items.source: This change affects You only if you operate directly on the mapping model.
items.translation: 此更改仅影响直接操作映射模型的用户。
